risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (417.4), flat yield curve signals recession risk, rising dollar pressures multinationals, and earnings event in 42 days adds execution risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term EMA structure (50/200) remains bullish with supertrend and hull confirmation; extreme fear sentiment (10/10) and congressional buying present contrarian opportunity near support at 61.17.
